source_row.rationale: Rifampin commonly causes a harmless orange-red discoloration of body fluids, including urine, sweat, tears, and saliva. Clients should be informed of this expected effect in advance to prevent unnecessary alarm, and those who wear soft contact lenses should be cautioned that the lenses may become permanently stained.
source_row.source_detail: Rifampin patient information: orange-red discoloration of urine, sweat, tears, saliva and possible contact-lens staining; reviewed 2026-08-14.
